# CA Pool Builders

> California pool builder license check, by Randy Beard. Every California C-53 pool contractor license from CSLB public data (as of 2026-11-06), by county and city, with status, bond, workers' comp and plain-language flags. No paid placement, no ratings.

- [California by county](https://capoolbuilders.com/directory/california/)
- [Before you sign a pool contract](https://capoolbuilders.com/before-you-sign/)
- [Pool contract review by Randy Beard](https://capoolbuilders.com/contract-review/)
- [About the publisher](https://capoolbuilders.com/about/)
